resolutionSummary: Kentridge now has one canonical town-authoring path through Game.WorldBuilder's WorldBuilderTownAuthoring API. The former package-owned Mountain Force World Generation implementation was consolidated under Assets/Game/WorldBuilder/Generation, VoxelShowcase and Kentridge scene/session callers were migrated away from direct legacy authoring, and the Game composition boundary now exposes Game-owned realization facts instead of MountingForce.WorldGen types. The focused ownership regression passed targeted CI exactly once, and a fresh-baked standalone VoxelShowcase replay using the saved SceneIssue view remained visually stable with no missing visible surface coverage. The durable plan explicitly records the intended follow-on boundary: Game.WorldBuilder owns semantic game intent while reusable physical layout/architecture/voxel realization should move behind VoxelEngine.WorldGen.
